caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, domed trunk positioned at a slight angle so that both the front and left sides are visible. The trunk appears worn, with patches of distress and peeling material exposing different textures and shades. The primary colors of the trunk are various muted tones of brown, gray, and yellow ochre, with areas of dark blue or black likely representing metal reinforcement bands and rivets. The trunk is adorned with vertical and horizontal metal strips secured with round rivets. On the left panel, the initials "J.W." are visible in white. The background is a plain off-white, and the trunk sits centrally with some shadowing underneath, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. A small signature of the artist appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Leather Covered Trunk
